summary: Frontend-only re-test (iteration 5) of SkillTrace AI on the public URL, focused on verifying the 5 fixes from iteration_4 plus regression. VERIFIED FIXED: (1) CRITICAL provider enroll now completes end-to-end (toast 'Trainee enrolled with consent captured', row appears in My Trainees, trainee stamped with provider_id) AND the duplicate-detection path works (duplicate-warning -> dup-force-create-btn -> enrollment completes, modal closes); DB confirmed 2 trainees + 2 enrollments + 2 consent logs created. (2) HIGH bogus JWT no longer crashes: localStorage skilltrace_token='bogus.token.value' + reload /provider -> clean redirect to /login, zero pageerrors, no 'Cannot read properties of null'. (3) MEDIUM stale quick-reply chips fixed: after a free-text reply only the CURRENT question's chips render (status chips 0, wage chips 4), and after selecting wage all chip groups disappear. (4) MEDIUM follow-up cycle now scoped to the caller provider: enrollments_processed=33 (was 139), returns in ~1.2s. (5) ethics/LOW gender factor gone: risk cards and /analytics/trainee/{id}/risk top factors show only attendance/score/sector/district for 6 sampled high-risk trainees. Regression pass: provider KPIs + 36-row trainee table + at-risk panel (19 high-risk), admin dashboard 4 KPIs + 6 Recharts render and react to district/gender filters (152 -> 41 -> 23), public /verify/:token full lifecycle (valid -> verified -> already responded -> invalid token), provider->/admin RBAC bounce back to /provider, logout clears token and returns to /login. One NEW medium bug found in MessagingSimulator (chat transcript reset wipes the user's free-text bubble; can also leave the chat with no chips). All QA_ data cleaned (trainees back to 150, QA employer + test employment record removed).

minor.issue: Still returns followups_created=0 while enrollments_processed=33, so the UI toast reads 'Follow-up cycle run: 0 check-ins scheduled across 33 certified trainees'. Scoping is fixed; consider surfacing 'nothing due' as an info toast instead of a success with 0 (cosmetic, pre-existing).

ui_bugs.issue: The user's free-text reply bubble is missing from the transcript. load() (useEffect + StrictMode double-mount) resolves a second time AFTER the user has interacted and does setMessages([greeting]), wiping already-pushed user messages. Observed transcript: greeting -> AI Classifier -> wage question, with the typed 'haan job lag gayi 18000 salary' bubble gone. In one run this reset also left the chat with the greeting but NO quick-reply chips (phase had advanced to 'wage' while messages were reset to the status greeting), i.e. the structured flow becomes unusable until reload. Fix: guard load() with a mounted/latest-request ref or only seed the greeting when messages.length === 0.

While the risk request is still in flight (or fails) the card renders 'No enrollment to assess', which is factually wrong for a trainee that does have an enrollment. Risk fetch is fire-and-forget (.catch(() => setRisk(null))) with no loading/error state. Add a skeleton/loading state and distinguish 'could not load risk' from 'no enrollment'.

issues: 'Non-Placement Reasons' donut renders blank on the initial unfiltered load in the screenshot (populates after a filter change) - verify the chart is not just late-animating on first paint
React console warning on every load: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' (invalid DOM nesting inside a select option) - harmless but noisy

action_items: MessagingSimulator: prevent the delayed load() from resetting messages after user interaction (mounted ref / seed greeting only when messages is empty)
TraineeProfile: add loading/error state for the risk fetch instead of falling back to 'No enrollment to assess'
Optional polish: follow-up cycle toast wording when 0 check-ins are due; fix invalid <span> inside <option> on Login
critical_code_review_comments: MessagingSimulator.load() unconditionally does setMessages([...]) inside an effect; any re-invocation (StrictMode, id change, late resolution) destroys conversation state. Seed once and keep phase/messages in sync.
TraineeProfile fires /analytics/trainee/{id}/risk outside the Promise.all with a silent catch, so a failed risk call is indistinguishable from 'no enrollment'.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 'QA_UI_Retest One' trainees (normal + force-create duplicate) and 1 verification token via qa_make_token.py; all removed afterwards with qa_cleanup.py plus manual deletion of the 'Employer (pending verification)' employment record created by the simulator test. DB back to 150 trainees / 126 employment records / 0 QA rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 iteration_4 defects are confirmed fixed on the public URL. Remaining open items are the MessagingSimulator transcript-reset bug (user free-text bubble disappears / chips can vanish) and the risk-card loading-state wording. When testing the simulator, always wait_for_selector on [data-testid=whatsapp-quick-reply-employed] before counting chips - counting immediately after the simulator container appears gives a false 0. Verify tokens: python /app/backend/tests/qa_make_token.py; cleanup: python /app/backend/tests/qa_cleanup.py.
rca_of_the_issue: Simulator bug RCA: `load` is a useCallback([traineeId]) invoked in useEffect; under React StrictMode the effect runs twice and the second async resolution lands after the user has already replied, calling setMessages([greeting]) and discarding pushUser/pushAI entries. Because `phase` is separate state and is NOT reset, the rebuilt greeting (chips:true) fails the `phase === 'status'` condition and no chips render at all - the exact 'no chips' state observed in one run.
